mapper.select: SELECT homepage_id, popup_idx, popup_name, html, html_use_yn, popup_type, link_url, use_yn, print_seq, width, height, x_position, y_position, org_file_name, server_file_name, file_extension, file_size, add_date, link_target, TO_CHAR(start_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS start_date, TO_CHAR(end_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS end_date, common_yn, alt_text, link_type FROM CMS_POPUP WHERE (homepage_id = #{homepage_id} OR (homepage_id = 'h32' AND common_yn = 'Y')) AND use_yn = 'Y' AND start_date <= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'yyyy-mm-dd') AND end_date >= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'yyyy-mm-dd') ORDER BY print_seq ASC, add_date DESC

SELECT homepage_id, popup_idx, popup_name, html, html_use_yn, popup_type, link_url, use_yn, print_seq, width, height, x_position, y_position, org_file_name, server_file_name, file_extension, file_size, add_date, link_target, TO_CHAR(start_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS start_date, TO_CHAR(end_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS end_date, common_yn, alt_text, link_type FROM CMS_POPUP WHERE homepage_id = #{homepage_id} AND popup_idx = #{popup_idx}
SELECT NVL(MAX(print_seq), 0) + 10 FROM CMS_POPUP WHERE homepage_id = #{homepage_id}
